mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, 5d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad consumer and housing sector weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative 60d returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a rising unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declining), labor market deterioration reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: rising unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS decline)
failure_condition: In the rising unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS decline), 20d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1150 thousand units, it signals a housing market collapse that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1150, 5d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a dual threat of monetary tightening and inflation, which compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative 60d returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment recession regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high unemployment recession regime (UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS decline), 20d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.
